verification: GSC Pages report per locale; third-party visibility trend in AUDIT CHANGELOG.
done_criteria: Coverage baseline stored; remediation plan approved for every non-indexed cluster.

title: No page shows its own publication or last-updated date; the dates exist only in JSON-LD and sitemap <lastmod>

verification: deep_audit.py: visible_date_pages = Hub/Supporting/Pillar/checklist count; the printed dates equal JSON-LD and lastmod.
done_criteria: Reviewed PR merged; build --check, seo-guard, fact-guard, tests PASS; live markup QA identical.

title: A topic slot exists in all 10 languages (same Matrix slot, cluster and silo) but its pages carry no hreflang: possible equivalent versions, currently NO_EQUIVALENT_BY_DESIGN
action: Editor decides per cluster whether the 10 pages are versions of the same page (same purpose and scope). If yes, add reciprocal hreflang between them in a reviewed PR (hreflang is a frozen fingerprint: selective re-freeze, seo-guard PASS); if not, keep NO_EQUIVALENT_BY_DESIGN and record the reason. Never pair pages that are not equivalent to raise hreflang counts.
expected_result: A documented decision per cluster; where equivalent, Google can show the right language version.
verification: HREFLANG & CANONICAL sheet: equivalence class per URL; seo-guard hreflang checks.
done_criteria: Decision recorded per cluster (and PR merged where approved).

title: Cover images offer only 640w and 1200w: phones with a 1.75–3× screen pick the 1200 px file, so Lighthouse reports 47–63 KB of image waste per guide
action: Add an intermediate cover width (e.g. 800w or 960w WebP, same image) to the srcset; keep sizes, width/height and alt unchanged.
expected_result: Smaller image transfer on phones without visible quality loss.
verification: Lighthouse 'properly size images' on the template sample.
done_criteria: Reviewed PR merged; image matrix regenerated.

title: Every page loads four render-blocking stylesheets (styles, navigation, premium, ultra ≈ 44 KB); most of ultra.css is unused on each template (lab, Lighthouse)
action: Merge the four files into one versioned stylesheet (or inline the critical above-the-fold rules and load the rest without blocking), and drop rules no template uses; keep the cache-busting query and build --check byte-identical.
expected_result: Fewer blocking requests; Lighthouse 'render-blocking resources' and 'unused CSS' pass on the template sample.
verification: Lighthouse on the template sample (lighthouse-20261101.json method).
done_criteria: Reviewed PR merged; tests and live markup QA PASS.
